title: multidms
summary: A JAX package that fits one model across multiple deep mutational scanning experiments, using a shared global epistasis model with sparse, regularized shift parameters to find mutations whose effects differ between conditions. Covers data encoding, model fitting, out-of-sample prediction, and interactive visualization.
description: Built on Google's JAX library, this open-source Python package provides utilities for jointly modeling multiple Deep Mutational Scanning datasets. Its interface helps users prepare and encode data, initialize and fit models, make out-of-sample predictions, and interactively visualize the inferred parameters. It adds to the growing set of tools for modeling DMS data and has produced results for multiple studies.

title: ReLERNN
summary: Recombination Landscape Estimation using Recurrent Neural Networks. A deep learning method, trained on simulated data, that estimates genome-wide recombination maps accurately even from small numbers of pooled or individually sequenced genomes.
description: *ReLERNN* is a Python-based CLI tool for *Re*combination-*L*andscape *E*stimation using *R*ecurrent *N*eural *N*etworks. This software implements a deep learning method for estimating a genome-wide recombination map that is accurate even with small numbers of pooled or individually sequenced genomes. Rather than use summaries of linkage disequilibrium as its input, ReLERNN takes columns from a genotype alignment, which are then modeled as a sequence across the genome using a recurrent neural network.

title: phippery
summary: A software suite for analyzing phage immunoprecipitation sequencing (PhIP-Seq) data. Includes a Nextflow pipeline for processing, a Python API for normalization and enrichment analysis, and a Streamlit app for interactive visualization.
description: The phippery suite analyzes data from phage display methods that use immunoprecipitation and deep sequencing to capture antibody binding to peptides, often called "PhIP-Seq" experiments. Its three components work separately or together: (i) phip-flow, a Nextflow pipeline that processes raw sequencing data into a compact, multidimensional dataset and automates reproducible end-to-end workflows; (ii) phippery, a Python API for count normalization, enrichment calculation, multidimensional scaling, and modeling significant peptide enrichment; and (iii) phip-viz, a Streamlit app for flexible, interactive heatmap visualization.
